mechanisms.name: Provenance-aware context reuse
mechanisms.hypothesis: Reusing fresh, provenance-linked context reduces repeated discovery cost without increasing stale-context errors.
mechanisms.trigger: A task repeatedly reconstructs the same repository or decision context.
mechanisms.intervention: Retrieve scoped, freshness-checked context references before broad rediscovery.
guardrails: Do not load secrets or excluded session data
Unknown and stale evidence remain explicit
mechanisms.notes: Hypothesis only; requires a frozen task cohort and comparison against the current retrieval baseline.

mechanisms.name: Idempotent workflow composition
mechanisms.hypothesis: Composing existing validated workflow steps with explicit receipts reduces handoff failures and duplicate execution.
mechanisms.trigger: A repeatable task crosses multiple agents, tools, or workflow boundaries.
mechanisms.intervention: Compose existing steps using stable IDs, idempotency keys, bounded retries, and explicit terminal-state checks.
mechanisms.notes: Hypothesis only; do not create a parallel scheduler or orchestration authority.

mechanisms.name: Outcome-triggered specialist escalation
mechanisms.hypothesis: Escalating only tasks that cross preregistered uncertainty or impact thresholds improves correctness per unit cost versus blanket escalation.
mechanisms.trigger: A task exceeds a defined uncertainty, risk, or impact threshold.
mechanisms.intervention: Route a bounded verification or specialist subtask to an independently configured agent/provider.
target_outcomes: Higher correctness on eligible high-risk tasks
No degradation in task completion time beyond the declared bound
guardrails: Thresholds and cohort frozen before experiment
mechanisms.notes: Hypothesis only; no routing behavior is changed by catalog registration.

mechanisms.name: Risk-weighted independent verification
mechanisms.hypothesis: Independent verification targeted by impact and uncertainty catches material defects more efficiently than uniform review intensity.
mechanisms.trigger: A change has elevated impact, uncertainty, or a weak single-source evidence chain.
mechanisms.intervention: Obtain an independent check against the acceptance contract and compare its findings with primary execution evidence.
target_outcomes: Higher defect detection on high-impact changes
guardrails: Agreement is not treated as proof without evidence
mechanisms.notes: Hypothesis only; requires blinded or otherwise bias-controlled evaluation where practical.

mechanisms.name: Evidence-driven orchestration adaptation
mechanisms.hypothesis: Using verified outcome and cost evidence to adapt orchestration improves portfolio performance over static routing without destabilizing service quality.
mechanisms.trigger: A completed, attributable cohort yields sufficient current outcome evidence.
mechanisms.intervention: Submit a bounded configuration candidate to the owning orchestration and DoE lanes for controlled comparison.
target_outcomes: Reduced resource cost at equal quality
No increase in instability or fairness regressions
guardrails: Use existing DoE and orchestration authorities
mechanisms.notes: Hypothesis only; candidate recommendations require separate authorization and owning-lane review.
